d: Short, curly pale blonde hair with blunt bangs and a slight side part frames a youthful, mature face with sharp, golden-yellow eyes. The slender build is dressed in a dark navy blue hooded cape with a grey lining, paired with a white chest piece and a matching dark navy blue open-front skirt. White thigh-high stockings with brown buckled straps, black lace-up boots, and a utility belt with gold ammunition pouches complete the outfit. Signature details include a large dark navy blue hood and a golden eye-shaped emblem on the front of the skirt.
